## Which module

Which part of the plugin this touches (a hook, a `scripts/` domain, a command,
an agent, a skill) and, if you know it, the file.

## What it blocks

What you cannot do today without this — the concrete task or workflow that is
stuck, not just "would be nice."

If this is about one of the optional modules — the panel, the usage views,
the ADO connector, the demo, or the theme editor — CONTRIBUTING.md's
"### Optional modules take fixes only (decided 2026-10-06): no new UI shape
pins, no new prose lints" already settled that these take fixes only until a
user asks, and this report is exactly the evidence its revisit trigger for
(a) waits for: "a user report that an optional module is blocking their work
on it, observed in an issue or a support thread." Say what you cannot do.

For anything else, if this reopens a question CONTRIBUTING.md's Decision
record already settled, say which entry and which revisit trigger your
report is evidence for; that record is where a NO-GO gets re-asked, not in a
new design from scratch.

## Proposed behavior

What you'd want to see instead.
